name: 6 Inch My Darling
source:
You play a high school student living with your parents and younger sister. On your way back from school, you stumble across a mysterious wooden box containing a strange figurine and an old letter. Thus your adventure begins...

Basically, this is a dating game, where you get to chaperone one of three 6-inch tall fairies from another world as they go about exploring your world (and sometimes making quite a mess while they're at it). Depending on how you do, you unlock various scenes/events throughout the game and maybe get a happy ending with the girl of your dreams. Along the way, you'll also be juggling your unsuspecting family and friends, including a real life female classmate who might turn out to be a love interest as well if you play your cards right.

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=54&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演一名与父母和妹妹共同生活的高中生。放学回家途中，你偶然发现一个神秘木盒，里面装着奇怪的人偶和一封旧信，冒险由此开始…

本作基本上是一款恋爱游戏。玩家要陪伴三名来自异世界、身高只有六英寸的妖精中的一人探索这个世界；她们有时也会在途中制造一团混乱。根据玩家表现，游戏会解锁不同场景与事件，最终或许能与梦中少女迎来幸福结局。与此同时，你还必须设法瞒过毫不知情的家人和朋友；其中也包括现实中的女同学，如果选择得当，她同样可能成为恋爱对象。

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=54&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
